en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a statue of Martin Luther in front of a Gothic church window. The monument stands on a pedestal inscribed in German, and surrounding it are bare shrubs and simple steps leading to a door in the church wall. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Dippoldiswalde and the subject as the Luther monument, along with the name of the local publisher.
